active_inquiry.closure_condition: Close after a full-radius-trained candidate has been compared with T1:checkpoint-120832 on identical non-overlapping official-distribution development seeds with episode success, radius- and angle-stratified first reach and minimum distance, maximum held steps, interruptions, and hold continuity. Continue full-radius exposure if inner-band acquisition improves materially without broad hold regression; redirect toward stabilization, branch/control, or dynamic/substep investigation if acquisition does not improve or hold failures become dominant. An inconclusive result may close the inquiry while preserving those unresolved alternatives.
active_inquiry.goal_connection: The best-known candidate reaches only 110/160 (68.75%) on the official-distribution development panel, far below the 196/200 objective. M1 shows 42/160 episodes with no first reach and 12/160 with hold interruptions, while T1 trained only on 14-20 cm targets. Testing full 6-20 cm exposure directly targets the largest observed acquisition gap without changing the protected task or success criterion.
active_inquiry.handoff_conclusion: Established observations: T1 trained the existing PPO recipe on only 14-20 cm targets for 120,000 requested steps and completed 120,832 actual steps. Its training proxy success rose late from 0.50 at 90,112 steps to 0.97 at 117,760-119,808 and 0.96 at 120,832; these are learning-proxy facts, not development performance. M1 evaluated the two late artifacts on the same 160 official-distribution seeds: T1:checkpoint-115712 achieved 105/160 (65.625%) and T1:checkpoint-120832 achieved 110/160 (68.75%), with 13 discordant episodes, 9 paired wins for the latter and 4 for the former. In the detailed artifacts, many failures at inner radii from roughly 6-13 cm have no first reach and large minimum distance; most episodes that do enter tolerance complete the 100-sample hold, but some reached episodes show repeated interruptions and do not succeed. Interpretation: the current evidence makes omitted inner-band exposure and radius/branch conditioning the leading route-relevant explanation for the dominant gap, while stabilization under the 50 Hz zero-order-held control loop remains a consequential secondary explanation. This is an artifact-level association, not a causal claim: the baseline recipe did not vary exposure independently of the learned artifact, and no joint/action/substep/contact traces or branch labels were recorded. Unknown compiled dynamics and the endpoint-versus-continuous hold distinction therefore remain unresolved, but they need not block the next exposure comparison unless full-radius training fails to improve acquisition or introduces broad hold failures.

request.description: Train the current baseline PPO policy with the existing 14-20 cm training-radius exposure, 64x64 tanh policy, and configured runtime parameters to establish the first candidate and learning trajectory.
request.rationale: The initial mechanistic distinction is exposure-limited generalization to the official 6-20 cm distribution versus a shared reach-and-hold stabilization limitation. This does not treat training proxies as performance evidence; it establishes the candidate needed for the next measurement.

request.description: Paired official-distribution development evaluation of the late baseline checkpoints T1:checkpoint-115712 and T1:checkpoint-120832, retaining episode-level geometry and reach/hold diagnostics.
request.rationale: These checkpoints are the strongest late artifacts by the preserved training trajectory, but their training proxies are tied and the terminal artifact is not scientifically privileged. Evaluating them on identical official-distribution seeds tests complete-candidate capability while preserving the mechanistic discriminator: target-radius and angle, first reach, minimum/final distance, maximum held steps, in-tolerance steps, and hold interruptions. A strong exposed-band result with inner-band degradation supports an exposure/conditioning direction; broad failure with short holds instead supports stabilization/control work. The evaluation will establish development evidence only, not the protected 200-episode assessment.

scientific_session.objective: Use the completed evidence to update the scientific direction toward the human goal. Correct inherited interpretations, constraints or proposed questions when existing evidence warrants it. Request measurements when they resolve an uncertainty or develop the method. Compare the two outcomes as contracts/program.md 'Goal review' defines and choose one: request the official assessment, whose pass or fail result ends this campaign, or open one bounded goal-linked inquiry.
